title: Test Day Checklist
summary: How to book, what to bring, how the test works and what to keep after it.

blocks.text: The CITB health, safety and environment test for operatives is the test for general site workers and a key part of getting a CSCS card. You book it online or by phone, and take it at a test centre.

blocks.title: Have this ready when you book
items: Your personal email address, for the confirmation.
Your full UK postal address.
The type of test: Operatives.
The test centre you want.
Your CITB registration number, if you've taken a test before or applied for a card.
A debit or credit card (or a CITB voucher).

blocks.title: Cost and changes
items: The test costs £23.50.
Online: reschedule free up to 72 hours before the test.
Online: cancel at least 72 hours before for a full refund.
By phone: £5 to reschedule; cancelling costs a £10 fee.
No changes are possible within 72 hours of the test.

blocks.title: See the screens first
blocks.text: CITB has a free demo test that shows the question styles. It isn't scored, but it helps you get used to how the test looks.

blocks.title: Before you go in
items: Arrive at least 15 minutes before your test starts.
Bring your booking confirmation email or letter.
Bring ID with your photo and signature.
Under 16? Bring a completed parental consent form too.

blocks.title: After the test
items: Keep your score report safe: it has information you need for your card application.
Use your maps to go back over any topic you found hard.

blocks.title: What the operatives test covers
items: Working environment
Occupational health
Safety
High risk activities
Specialist
